description: This file defines a validation rule class 'ProvinceCode' used within the OrangeHRM system to validate province codes, specifically checking if a given input corresponds to a Province entity retrieved via the CountryService.

classes.name: ProvinceCode
classes.description: A validation rule class extending AbstractRule to verify if a given province code is valid within the system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input as a string representing a province code, returning true if the code corresponds to an existing Province entity.
